trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"src-vul/json-c-json-c-0.16-20220414/json_object.c","function":"json_object_object_add_ex","line":565,"var":"k","code":"k = strdup(key) when JSON_C_OBJECT_ADD_CONSTANT_KEY is not set","note":"A caller-supplied key is duplicated and stored in the hash table as heap memory owned by the object."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src-vul/json-c-json-c-0.16-20220414/json_object.c","function":"json_object_object_add_ex","line":568,"var":"val","code":"lh_table_insert_w_hash(..., k, val, hash, opts)","note":"The new key/value pair is inserted into the object's lh_table, transferring ownership of the duplicated key to the table entry."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src-vul/json-c-json-c-0.16-20220414/json_object.c","function":"json_object_object_del","line":624,"var":"key","code":"lh_table_delete(JC_OBJECT(jso)->c_object, key)","note":"Deleting a field looks up the entry and removes it from the table, which triggers the table's entry free callback."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src-vul/json-c-json-c-0.16-20220414/json_object.c","function":"json_object_lh_entry_free","line":502,"var":"ent->k","code":"if (!lh_entry_k_is_constant(ent)) free(lh_entry_k(ent));","note":"The free callback releases the duplicated key unless it was marked constant."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src-vul/json-c-json-c-0.16-20220414/json_object.c","function":"json_object_lh_entry_free","line":504,"var":"ent->v","code":"json_object_put((struct json_object *)lh_entry_v(ent));","note":"The callback decrements the value object's reference count and may destroy the child object when it reaches zero."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src-vul/json-c-json-c-0.16-20220414/json_object.c","function":"json_object_put","line":289,"var":"jso","code":"if (jso->_user_delete) jso->_user_delete(jso, jso->_userdata);","note":"When the refcount drops to zero, any user delete hook runs before the object-specific destructor."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src-vul/json-c-json-c-0.16-20220414/json_object.c","function":"json_object_put","line":293,"var":"jso->o_type","code":"switch (jso->o_type) { case json_type_object: json_object_object_delete(jso); ... }","note":"For object values, destruction dispatches to the object destructor, which frees the backing hash table."},
  {"step":8,"file":"src-vul/json-c-json-c-0.16-20220414/json_object.c","function":"json_object_object_delete","line":509,"var":"JC_OBJECT(jso_base)->c_object","code":"lh_table_free(JC_OBJECT(jso_base)->c_object);","note":"Freeing the hash table walks all entries and invokes the same entry-free callback again for each stored child."},
  {"step":9,"file":"src-vul/json-c-json-c-0.16-20220414/json_tokener.c","function":"json_tokener_reset_level","line":194,"var":"tok->stack[depth].current","code":"json_object_put(tok->stack[depth].current);","note":"The parser also releases partially built objects during reset, so a malformed input that drives nested object construction can reach the same destructor path."},
  {"step":10,"file":"src-vul/json-c-json-c-0.16-20220414/linkhash.c","function":"lh_table_free","line":570,"var":"t->free_fn(c)","code":"for (c = t->head; c != NULL; c = c->next) t->free_fn(c);","note":"The table destructor iterates entries and calls the free callback on each one, so a stale or already-freed child pointer is freed again here, causing the invalid-free sink."}
]
with open(p,'w') as f:
    json.dump(trace,f,separators=(',',':'))
PY
